metric.readiness.name: Readiness
metric.readiness.desc: How recovered you are for load. Made up of sleep, HRV, resting HR, recent load and stress. Above baseline = fresh; below - the body is under-recovered.
metric.hrv.name: HRV
metric.hrv.desc: Heart rate variability - the spread between heartbeats overnight. Reflects the balance of the nervous system. At or above baseline - recovered; a drop below baseline - fatigue, stress, lack of sleep.
metric.rhr.name: Resting HR
metric.rhr.desc: Lowest heart rate during sleep. The lower, the better the recovery and fitness. Above baseline - a sign of under-recovery, illness or stress.
metric.sleep.name: Sleep, h
metric.sleep.desc: Sleep duration overnight. Baseline is your typical norm. Below baseline hits recovery, HRV and readiness, especially before strength work.
metric.bb.name: Overnight charge
metric.bb.desc: Body Battery - how much energy built up overnight (0-100). Your reserve for the day. Below baseline - didn't fully recharge.
metric.sleep_score.name: Sleep score
metric.sleep_score.desc: Garmin's sleep quality score (0-100) based on phases, movement, heart rate. Below baseline - sleep was choppy, even if the hours were enough.
metric.spo2.name: SpO₂
metric.spo2.desc: Blood oxygen saturation at night (Pulse Ox). Normal is 95-100%. Dips of the minimum below 90% - possible breathing pauses in sleep; they explain poor recovery despite normal sleep duration.
metric.respiration.name: Respiration
metric.respiration.desc: Breathing rate during sleep (breaths per minute). Lower in sleep is normal. Steadily elevated vs baseline is an early sign of illness, stress or overload.
metric.sleep_deep.name: Deep sleep
metric.sleep_deep.desc: Hours of deep sleep per night - the main phase of physical recovery (growth hormone, muscle repair). Below baseline means worse recovery even if total sleep hours were fine.
metric.sleep_rem.name: REM sleep
metric.sleep_rem.desc: Hours of REM sleep per night - the phase for the nervous system, memory and learning. Below baseline means worse cognitive recovery; often hurt by late alcohol and late bedtime.
metric.vo2max.name: VO₂max
metric.vo2max.desc: Estimated maximal oxygen uptake - the main marker of aerobic fitness. Grows slowly; a rise = endurance progress, a plateau needs a new stimulus (aerobic base).
metric.acwr.name: ACWR
metric.acwr.desc: Ratio of acute load (7 days) to chronic load (28 days). Below 0.8 - underload (fresh, room to spare); 0.8-1.3 - normal (optimal); above 1.3 - overload (fatigue building, injury risk).
metric.load_debt.name: Load debt
metric.load_debt.desc: Recent load's contribution to readiness (derived from ACWR). Overload (ACWR above 1) drags readiness down - a minus; underload (below 1) adds freshness - a plus. Range ±30.
metric.monotony.name: Monotony
metric.monotony.desc: How uniform the weekly load is (mean divided by spread). High (>2) - days look alike, monotonous, risk of stagnation and overload. Lower - more varied.
metric.strain.name: Strain
metric.strain.desc: Weekly stress from load (volume times monotony). High - a heavy, intense week; alternate with a deload.
